a) $x \left(3 - x\right) + \left(x - 3\right)^{2}$

b) $\left(x + 1\right)^{2} + \left(x + 2\right) \left(x + 6\right)$

c) $\left(x - 4\right) \left(x + 4\right) - \left(x + 1\right) \left(x + 2\right)$

d) $\left(y - 3\right) \left(y + 3\right) \left(y^{2} + 9\right) - \left(y^{2} - 6\right) \left(y^{2} + 6\right)$
\loigiai{
a) $x \left(3 - x\right) + \left(x - 3\right)^{2}=9 - 3 x$\\
b) $\left(x + 1\right)^{2} + \left(x + 2\right) \left(x + 6\right)=2 x^{2} + 10 x + 13$\\
c) $\left(x - 4\right) \left(x + 4\right) - \left(x + 1\right) \left(x + 2\right)=- 3 x - 18$\\
d) $\left(y - 3\right) \left(y + 3\right) \left(y^{2} + 9\right) - \left(y^{2} - 6\right) \left(y^{2} + 6\right)=-117$
}\end{ex}

\begin{ex}%[8D2N1]
